pages.text: Your class defines your combat role. It modifies your HP, your weapon effectiveness, and grants you passive abilities.$(br2)$(bold)There are 10 classes.$() All are viable. There is no 'best' class — only classes that match different playstyles.$(br2)$(bold)Respeccing:$() Classes can be changed at a $(bold)Class Altar$() — a craftable station requiring a tier-appropriate boss drop + 30 XP levels. Skill points are not lost.

$(bold)The Ten Classes$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Berserker$() — Axe melee, low-HP rage$(li)$(bold)Samurai$() — Katana precision, movement shield$(li)$(bold)Battlemage$() — Melee/magic hybrid$(li)$(bold)Wanderer$() — Jack of all trades, explorer$(li)$(bold)Paladin$() — Tank/support, healing aura$(li)$(bold)Vanguard$() — Pure tank, -15% damage$(li)$(bold)Ranger$() — Ranged glass cannon$(li)$(bold)Archmage$() — Magic glass cannon$(li)$(bold)Artificer$() — Builder, no combat penalty$(li)$(bold)Void Summoner$() — Minion master, darkness
